revenue_items.bye_law_description: Assessed on all ratable properties at 4% of annual value. Collected by the Valuation Office under this department.

revenue_items.item_name: Stacking of Building Material / Construction Permit
revenue_items.bye_law_description: Fees for stacking building materials on streets; includes daily charges for unlawful stacking. Part VIII (Part B) covers construction site permits, including special permits for pile driving.
Fee of ₦15,000 minimum for cutting road tar for speed breakers, water pipes, or cables.
Fees paid by individuals who want streets/roads named after them. Applications may be processed by the Department of Education, Social, Information, Sports and Culture.
Annual parking permits for corporate bodies and institutions, together with penalties and recovery fees for illegally parked or abandoned vehicles.

Monthly waste management charges for residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional premises. Part V (Section 6.6) covers fees collected during inspection of premises for sanitary compliance. Administered with the Environmental Sanitation and Waste Management Authority.
Fees for establishing/operating public toilets; annual renewal fees.
₦100,000 annual registration for private dislodging vehicles.
₦100,000 annual registration for private pest control firms operating in Kuje.
Registration and licensing of PSP refuse operators.
Fees for fumigation of food premises before registration. Issued also as the Pest Control Certificates the Medical and Health Care Department requires before registering a food premises.

Fees for issuance of certificate of fitness for habitation/continued habitation. Gazette Schedule C prices this by establishment type and by old building / new building / renewal; those figures await council confirmation and are not seeded as bands.

revenue_items.item_name: Trade License, Private Lockup Shops and Allied Matters
revenue_items.bye_law_description: Annual license fees for all businesses, shops, kiosks, workshops, and corporate offices.
Registration fees for contractors (construction, supply, services, consultancy).
Fees paid by intending contractors for tender documents.

revenue_items.item_name: Agreement Fees on Sale of Land and Other Disposition
revenue_items.bye_law_description: Fees for land agreements and other dispositions.
Processing fees for C of O.
Fees for transfer of property ownership.
Fees for land searches.
Annual levy on residents (individuals and corporate bodies) except exempted categories. Collected and enforced by the Area Council Revenue Committee.

revenue_items.item_name: Registration of Marriages, Births and Death
revenue_items.bye_law_description: Fees for registering marriages, births, and deaths.
Annual license fees on radio/TV sets and communication masts.
Fees for branded/operational vehicles used for advertisement. Collected by the Internal Revenue General Committee.
Annual fees for tavern, wine/beer, hotel, club, wholesale, and retail liquor licenses.
Annual license fees on communication masts, licensed under the same bye-law as radio and television sets.
Annual registration fees for hotels, guest inns, restaurants, bakeries, dairies, aerated water manufacturers, and food-related establishments.
Permits for foodstuff premises and food handlers.
Permit fees for fixed advertisements such as billboards, signboards, neon signs, banners, etc.
Fees for allocation of trade sites within the Council.
Fees for registration of voluntary, self-help, and social organizations.
License fees for cinema houses and viewing centres.
Fees for vaccination, animal treatment, and slaughterhouse supervision. Health oversight is provided by the Medical and Health Care Department.
Fees for forest produce measurement, assessment, and royalties.
Fees for tractor hiring services and agricultural training programmes.
Fees for fishery extension services and demonstrations.
Registration fees for cooperative societies.
